artworks.title: Statue of Minerva
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a standing figure holding a spear in their right hand and a circular object in their left hand. The person wears a classical-style helmet with a plume and a flowing garment with intricate detailing. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Roma, from the Base of the Antonine Column
artworks.medium: brown ink and gray wash over black chalk, the figure on the left in black chalk, on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a seated figure with a shield. The figure is depicted in a classical style, seated on steps, holding a circular shield decorated with a face. The figure is wearing a helmet with a crest and a draped garment. In its raised left hand, the figure appears to be gesturing or holding something. To the left side of the drawing, there is a preliminary sketch of what looks like drapery or a cloak. The drawing is executed with fine lines and subtle shading to emphasize the three-dimensionality and texture of the figure’s attire, as well as the details on the shield.

artworks.title: Draped Woman from the Villa Pamphili
artworks.medium: black ink and gray wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person in profile view wearing a draped garment that covers their entire body, including their head. The person's facial features are delicate, with a straight nose and closed lips. Their hair is intricately styled and covered by the garment. The outfit consists of a draped robe with pleats and folds. The person's feet are partially visible, indicating possible barefootedness. They are holding one edge of the garment towards their chest with one hand while the other hand is inside the folds of the robe. The background is a plain, light surface, emphasizing the figure.

artworks.title: Woman with a Pitcher, from the Palazzo Mattei
artworks.medium: dark brown ink and gray wash over graphite on beige laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body profile of a person standing and facing left. The person is slightly leaning forward and holding a large, ornate jug with both hands. They are depicted in a flowing robe, barefoot, with a draped headpiece and styled hair. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Woman with a Garland, from the Villa Pamphili
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper

artworks.title: Woman from a Procession, from the Palazzo Mattei
artworks.medium: pen and dark brown ink with gray wash over graphite on beige laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in profile facing right. The person has a soft facial profile with a slightly prominent nose. The hair is styled in long, wavy locks that extend down the back. The person is wearing a flowing, draped garment resembling a toga or gown. The right arm is extended outward holding a staff with a curved top, and the left arm is also extended holding an elongated item. The background is plain and neutral.

artworks.title: The Blinding of Elymas
artworks.medium: black ink over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows multiple figures in dynamic postures, with one central figure standing with raised arms, surrounded by onlookers who are seated or kneeling. The figures are mostly men with curly hair and some have beards, wearing draped garments similar to classical togas. The scene is set indoors with architectural features like arches and columns in the background. No jewelry or specific objects are highlighted in the scene, which focuses on the interactions and expressions of the figures within an architectural interior.

artworks.title: Comic Warrior, Seated Woman, and Figure with a Shield
artworks.medium: transfer tracing on oiled laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures engaged in a scene. The central figure is seated upon a classical chair, pointing their right hand upwards and resting their left arm on their knee. To their left, one figure appears to be running or dancing, with one arm raised and the other holding a circular shield. On the right, another figure stands poised with a large decorative shield and a helmet adorned with a plume. The drawing uses fine lines on a neutral-toned background to convey the scene.

artworks.title: Gods and a Goddess in Conversation
artworks.medium: transfer tracing on oiled laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four figures arranged in a slightly circular composition. One figure is seated on a piece of furniture with curved legs, draped in fabric and gesturing with an upward-pointing hand. Next to this figure is a partially clothed figure seated on what appears to be fabric. To the left of these figures is a naked standing figure with a muscular build, seemingly in dialogue with the seated draped figure. On the right is another unclothed figure with wings, seated in a relaxed position. The style of the drawing is reminiscent of classical and renaissance studies, characterized by delicate and precise line work on a textured paper background.

artworks.title: Satyr and Maenad, from Dance in Honor of Bacchus
artworks.medium: transfer tracing on oiled laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures engaged in an interaction. The image showcases a sketch in a classical style depicting two human figures. The figure on the left appears to be male and is shown with a beard, reaching out towards the other figure. The right figure seems feminine, slightly turned away and holding an object aloft. The figures are rendered in a simple, linear style emphasizing outline and form rather than detailed shading. The simplicity and linear quality suggest an emphasis on expression and movement.

artworks.title: Woman with a Dish and Various Classical Figures
artworks.medium: transfer tracing on oiled laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of five mythical figures in a classical style. The figures are sketched with minimal lines, depicting a scene involving interactions between characters. From left to right, the first figure holds a stick and points. The second figure is standing, holding a platter and dressed in detailed attire suggestive of ancient garb. The third figure is seated, holding a staff and is in a relaxed posture, gazing sideways. Adjacent to this figure is another seated individual wearing flowing clothes, also holding a slender object. Lastly, a partially seated figure on the right gestures skyward with one hand. The drawing uses thin, delicate lines to outline the characters, focusing on graceful poses and historical clothing without detailed shading.

artworks.title: Tracings of Classical Subjects
artworks.medium: black chalk tracing on oiled laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various classical and mythological scenes and figures. The drawing includes sketches depicting scenes and figures from classical mythology, such as warriors, battle scenes, and profiles of figures representing gods or mythical heroes. The figures are detailed with fine line work, capturing expressions and movements. Each sketch is accompanied by handwritten notes or labels.

artworks.title: Studies of Classical Women, with Eros
artworks.medium: transfer tracing with gray wash on oiled laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various mythological figures engaged in different activities. The scene is spread across a parchment-like background, depicting multiple figures in a classical style reminiscent of ancient Greek or Roman art. On the left, there is a central pedestal with a winged figure standing on it, holding a cloth, surrounded by a vase and two standing figures. To the right, several figures in flowing robes engage in various activities; some are standing, gesturing as if communicating, while others are seated. There are also items such as a box, and a musical instrument or tool being handled by seated figures. The composition suggests a narrative tableau depicting a mythological event or story.

artworks.title: Warriors with Victims, and Other Classical Subjects
artworks.medium: black chalk tracing on oiled laid paper with black chalk notations
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring various classical figures and scenes. The sketches show figures in classical armor and robes engaging in activities such as carrying, fighting, and conversing. Mythological creatures like centaurs and Greek gods are also depicted. The scenes are marked with Latin inscriptions. The sketches are minimally detailed and rendered in a linear and schematic style. The composition is systematic with evenly spaced placements.

artworks.title: Dancing and Piping Figures
artworks.medium: transfer tracing on oiled laid paper
artworks.description: This is an image of three mythological figures. The drawing shows three individuals engaged in a scene of music and dance. One man holds a lyre and an animal, a woman holds a circular object, possibly a tambourine, and another man is nude. The figures are depicted with simple and precise line work and minimal shading, giving a sense of movement and fluidity. The bearded man on the left appears to be playing a double pipe with a small animal beside him. The central female figure wears a flowing dress and dynamic pose. The nude male figure to the right has one leg slightly raised. The style is reminiscent of classical antiquity with an emphasis on elegance and mythological themes.

artworks.title: Atlas and One of the Hesperides
artworks.medium: transfer tracing on oiled laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a mythical figure with animalistic features and a human form, engaged in a dynamic pose with raised arms and a bent knee stance. Beside the figure, another figure in an elaborate draped garment with arms extended towards the mythical being. The scene is depicted with simple, clear line work on a textured background.

artworks.title: Women at an Altar
artworks.medium: transfer tracing on oiled laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays two full-length figures positioned on either side of a central column or pedestal. Both figures are depicted in profile and dynamic poses. The figure on the left has her body slightly turned towards the viewer, with one arm raised and the other extended outward, and her hair styled up and away from her face. The figure on the right is leaning forward towards the column, with her hair styled upwards. Both figures wear long, flowing garments that suggest drapery and ancient attire. The clothing is minimally detailed, focusing on motion rather than embellishment. One figure holds a rectangular object while the other appears to be reaching out as if to adjust or interact with the column or pedestal, which is adorned with a rounded object. The background is plain, directing focus on the figures and the ornate column between them.

artworks.title: Two Figures with a Mirror
artworks.medium: transfer tracing on oiled laid paper
artworks.description: The image features two individuals, one standing and one seated on a cloud. The standing figure has their head turned to the right, with delicately outlined facial features and styled hair. They wear a long, flowing garment and hold a fan or leaf in one hand and a round object in the other. The seated figure has detailed facial features and wings on their back. They are partly exposed, wearing simple attire and holding a glass orb or scepter in one hand, with a bracelet on the other wrist. The background is plain, emphasizing the outlined figures with a simplistic style focused on linework.

artworks.title: Athena Pouring a Drink for Hercules
artworks.medium: transfer tracing on oiled laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures interacting in an ancient or classical style. The image depicts two individuals, one standing on the left holding a cup and the other on the right pouring liquid from a jug into the cup. The figure on the left is dressed in a simple garment, tied around the waist, and appears barefoot, leaning slightly with interest toward the pouring jug. The figure on the right wears a more elaborate, patterned robe with ornate detailing and holds a long staff. The drawing is executed in fine lines on a textured paper.

artworks.title: Double-Handled Vase
artworks.medium: transfer tracing on oiled laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a hand-drawn illustration of a large amphora-style vase. The color palette consists of beige tones with dark brown outlines delineating the geometric patterns and details on the vase. The vase is positioned centrally in the image, with two handles on either side of the neck and a decorative band around the middle of the body.

artworks.title: Double-Handled Pot
artworks.medium: transfer tracing on oiled laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a line drawing of a cooking pot with a lid, featuring handles shaped like hands. The color palette is minimal, with beige paper and dark lines. The pot is central in the composition, with a curved base and lid at the top, and handles on both sides.

artworks.title: Round Pitcher
artworks.medium: transfer tracing on oiled laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a large jug with a handle on its left side and an elongated neck. The jug is decorated with vertical lines on its body. The color scheme is primarily beige and brown. The jug is centered in the image, with its handle extending to the left edge. Dark lines outline the jug and its patterns against a lighter background.

artworks.title: Greek Vase
artworks.medium: transfer tracing on oiled laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a decorative vase with two handles extending upward and outward. The vase is adorned with the outline of a human figure. The color palette includes light beige and black. The vase is centrally placed on the paper with a wide body on top of a narrower pedestal base, and the human figure is placed in the center of the vase's body.

artworks.title: Woman with Tambourines
artworks.medium: transfer tracing on oiled laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a line drawing of a full-length figure of a person. The individual is standing upright and facing slightly to the right. Their head is turned to the side with distinct facial features visible. The person is dressed in a draped garment that flows from the shoulders to the feet. The right arm is extended downward, holding a round object. Another larger round object is depicted in the background behind the person's left side. In the background, there is a sketch of a raised hand. The paper on which the drawing is made is textured and slightly discolored, with visible wear along the edges.
